name: 27615-logprobdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; pipeline-parallel-size > 1 is refused in this mode.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 128, bounded at 2048 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket. Prompt exactly 256 tokens (min = max = 256), output exactly 512 (min = max = 512) with `ignore_eos`. Every request carries `spec.backend.sampling_params = {temperature: 0.0, logprobs: 5}`; `prompt_logprobs` is not requested.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant returning top-five token probabilities on long replies for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 111faf11185a75435403e3843e9a21a57cf84ccb. Interpreter and hardware: env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

async-scheduling: true

# HAZARD at this commit: async scheduling raises ValueError on pipeline-parallel-size > 1 and on
# any speculative config, and accepts only the mp / uni / external_launcher executor backends.
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

# Off (the engine's default is on) so that how many prompt tokens are actually prefilled does not
# become a function of arrival order and cache residency.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# What `vllm serve` resolves to on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card, written down so they cannot drift.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
